tools.name: get_conditions
tools.description: Facts for ONE covered spot over up to 7 days: 3-hour forecast periods with condition score (0-100) and rating, water visibility (ft), swell height/period/direction, wind, tide state and height, water temperature, plus tide events and data quality. Pass a spot id, or lat+lon to use the nearest covered spot within 30 km. Free.

spot.description: Spot id, e.g. "electric-beach". Pass this OR lat+lon.

lat.description: Latitude; snaps to the nearest covered spot within 30 km.

from.description: First day, spot-local YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

to.description: Last day, inclusive. At most 7 days after from. Default: from + 6.

tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: Which regions and spots KaiCast covers, and whether each region supports ranked decisions (spot picks and best-day answers) or facts only. Also lists supported activities and how directly each is modeled. Anywhere not listed is not covered. Free.

tools.name: recommend_spot
tools.description: Ranked top picks (max 5) for an activity in one area on one day — by region id, or lat+lon with a radius. Each pick has the best daylight window, why (from the published conditions), a confidence score with its factors, caveats, and a KaiCast spot card. Returns status "not_covered" / "conditions_only" / "activity_not_modeled" honestly instead of guessing. Activities: snorkel (native model), dive, freedive, spearfish (proxy model; spots in water closed to spearfishing are excluded), surf (not modeled). Free during early access.

lat.description: Latitude, decimal degrees. Use with lon.

lon.description: Longitude, decimal degrees. Use with lat.

radius_km.description: Search radius around lat/lon in km (default 40, max 100).

activity.description: What the user wants to do.

date.description: Spot-local day to plan for. Default: today, or tomorrow once today's daylight has passed. Up to 6 days ahead.

tools.name: best_day
tools.description: Which day in a window (max 7 days) is best for an activity at a destination — a spot, a region, or lat+lon with a radius — and why, versus the runner-up. Returns every day's best score, confidence, caveats and a KaiCast spot card for the winner. Free during early access.

lat.description: Latitude, decimal degrees. Use with lon.

lon.description: Longitude, decimal degrees. Use with lat.

radius_km.description: Search radius around lat/lon in km (default 40, max 100).

activity.description: What the user wants to do.

to.description: Window end, inclusive, at most 7 days. Default: from + 6.

tools.name: get_seasonality
tools.description: What a place is usually like in a given month, for trip planning months ahead: per month, sea-surface temperature (p10/p50/p90 °C), wave height (p50/p90 m), wind (p50/p90 m/s), share of rough days, model water visibility (p25/p50/p75 m, low confidence), tropical-cyclone frequency, wildlife seasons, access rules and best activities. Every field carries its sources; curated seasons are drafts pending local review. Pass an area id, a spot id, or lat+lon, and optionally a month range. Free.

spot.description: Spot id; resolves to the area containing it.

lat.description: Latitude; resolves to the nearest covered area within 50 km. Use with lon.

month_to.description: Last month, 1-12, inclusive; wraps the year (11 to 2 = Nov-Feb).

tools.name: best_months
tools.description: Ranks the calendar months for one thing at one place: an activity (dive, snorkel, freedive, whale_swim), a species (e.g. manta, whale shark), or calm seas / warm water / clear water. Says whether the ranking comes from multi-year data or curated research seasons, with confidence and caveats. A decision call: metered, free during early access.

spot.description: Spot id; resolves to the area containing it.

lat.description: Latitude; resolves to the nearest covered area within 50 km. Use with lon.

for.description: What to plan for: an activity (dive, snorkel, freedive, whale_swim), a species word (e.g. "manta", "whale shark"), or calm / warm / clear.
